ONGC Scholarship to Meritorious SC/ST Category students 2026-27 scheme
ONGC Scholarship to Meritorious SC/ST Category students 2026-27 scheme

ONGC scholarship scheme for students is an exclusive scholarship opportunity for students belonging to SC/ST category who are studying in the first year of Engineering, MBBS, MBA and Master in Geophysics/Geology programme

The aim of this scholarship is to provide financial support to the meritorious students belonging to the marginalized sections of the society. Selected 1000 students will receive a scholarship of Rs. 48,000 each on an annual basis to enable them to complete their education.

ParametersSC/ST Category
NationalityIndian
Academic qualificationCandidate should be a student of 1st year of Graduate Engineering or MBBS courses or 1st year of Master’s degree in Geoscience or MBA. The scholarship shall be admissible only for pursuing full-time regular courses by AICTE/ MCI/UGC/Association of Indian Universities/State Education Boards/State Government/Central Government.
PercentileHave secured a minimum 60% marks in class 12 for Engineering/MBBS course and a minimum of 60% marks in graduation for PG courses in Geoscience/MBA (Note: The minimum OGPA/CGPA should be 6.0 in 10 points scale of grading system)
Gross annual family incomeHave a gross family income of less than Rs. 4.5 Lakhs per annum from all sources.
Age limitNot be more than 30 years of age as on 1st August 2026
Course typeRegular full time course

Terms and Conditions:
  1. Student should be belonging to SC/ST category pursuing eligible courses in the 1st year of College / University / Institute during the year of advertisement and subsequently continued for prescribed duration subject to prescribed conditions.
  2. 50% scholarships are reserved for girl students
  3. Students need to maintain a minimum of 60% or 6 grade points out of 10 in each year’s semester examination to ensure the continuation of the scholarship. The selected candidate must not be availing the benefits of any other scholarship or financial assistance from any other source.
  4. Students belonging to other categories (General, OBC) shall apply in their respective schemes as and when announced and not under this scheme.
  5. SC/ST caste certificate issued by competent government authorities is to be furnished.
  6. The scholarship is admissible for full-time regular courses only.
  7. Students must ensure they provide the active bank account details which should not likely to be changed later after selection.
  8. Active mobile number and email are requested to be provided.
  9. The specific zone where a student can apply for this scholarship depends on the location of the University/Institute/College in which the student was studying for the qualifying examination.
  10. Student shall be eligible for ONGC Scholarship scheme (if selected, as per the eligibility criteria) only for one course of study once in lifetime.
  11. Decision of the ONGC with regard to selection will be final. No correspondence on the selection process will be entertained.
  12. Company has the discretion to alter or discontinue the scholarship without any prior notice.
  13. The award of the scholarship shall not confer any right of employment with ONGC group of companies or its joint ventures.
  14. In case, of any information declared at the time of initial online application is found incorrect during scrutiny or thereafter, the application of such candidates shall be summarily rejected. Submission of false or malafide information shall be a disqualifier and such students shall be barred from applying thereafter for ONGC Scholarship and reported to their Institution authorities. A comprehensive list of such debarred students will be maintained to identify any resubmission of application subsequent years.
Documents required to be submitted by the applicants.
  1. Certified copy of Caste Certificate in Hindi/English. (Vernacular may be provide in extreme case)
  2. Copy of Birth Certificate/Class 10 Mark sheet as proof of age.
  3. Copy of Class 12-mark sheet in case of Engineering/MBBS students.
  4. Copy of consolidated Graduation mark sheet in case of MBA/Master's in Geology/Geophysics students.
  5. Certified copy of annual income certificate of the family in Hindi/English language. (Vernacular may be provide in extreme case)
  6. Bank details of the applicant in the ECS form attested by the bank as prescribed.
  7. Copy of PAN card or the tentative date for submission of PAN card copy (in case it is not available.
  8. Copy of College/Institution Id
  9. Copy of Colleges/Institution Admission Receipt
  10. Copy of undertaking.
1000* scholarships worth Rs. 48,000/- per annum each ONGC Foundation offers scholarships to meritorious SC/ST category students pursuing professional courses in Engineering, Medical stream and Master’s degree course in Business Administration, Geology and geophysics.

ONGC MERITORIOUS SCHOLARSHIP

How to Apply & Application Guidelines


ATTENTION: Mandatory Prerequisite

Before proceeding with your ONGC Meritorious Scholarship application, all candidates must first register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) . You are required to obtain a One-Time Registration (OTR) Number to validate your eligibility and finalize your submission.


Application procedure:

Step 1: Obtain NSP One-Time Registration (OTR) Number

Visit the National Scholarship Portal (NSP Portal) and complete your registration to generate your mandatory OTR Number. Keep this number accessible for your ONGC application.

Step 2: Register on the ONGC Portal

Access the official portal at www.ongcscholar.org.

  • New Users: Click on 'First Time Registrant', fill in the details matching your NSP Portal profile, and click 'Register for Passkey'. Save the passkey sent to your registered email/mobile.
  • Existing Users: Log in directly using your registered mobile number and passkey.

Step 3: Complete the Scholarship Application

Log in to the ONGC portal, navigate to the 'Apply Scholarship' tab, enter your NSP OTR Number, and accurately fill in all required personal and academic details.

Step 4: Submit Documents and Hard Copies

Upload all requested supporting documents. Ensure all certificates are duly certified and attested by the Head/Principal/Dean of your Institute/College/University. Hard copies of the completed form and attested documents must reach the designated ONGC office as specified in the application format

Selection Procedure:
  • Selection of candidate will be made on the basis of aggregate marks obtained in the qualifying examination prescribed for each eligible course of study. In case of students having equal marks in the qualifying examination students with lower family income will be selected.
  • Preference shall be given to students from below poverty line (BPL) families and other students shall be considered only if sufficient number of students from BPL families fulfilling the eligibility criteria is not available.
Disbursement of Scholarship:
  1. The scholarship will cover lump sum amount of Rs. 4000/- (Four Thousand) per month i.e. Rs. 48000/- Per Annum
  2. The amount shall be paid on yearly basis after completion of the academic year. The amount of scholarship will be deposited directly in the bank account of students through ECS facility.
  3. Once awarded, the scholarship shall be continued every year till the completion of the course subject to promotion of the student to the next year of his/her course. Scholarship shall be discontinued if the candidate is not promoted to the next year by their respective Institute/College/University. For the continuation of the scholarship, the students will have to send an online ‘Application for renewal’ in the prescribed format.
  4. In case the student opts for any different scholarship subsequently after award of ONGC Scholarship, he/she should have to refund the entire scholarship amount received from ONGC Foundation.
